verdict.rationale: Headless or CI operation is a fair question for a terminal product, but the evidence only shows scripting of the running macOS GUI app. The Python API and AppleScript can launch the app and open sessions, and long-lived session servers keep shells alive across crashes. None of this documents a headless mode or CI usage, so it counts only as adjacent automation of the GUI, not the requested capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
